# #773 — pr-body: contract-paths detection uses a two-dot diff, so any branch behind main trips Contract Parity

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-08-26T07:38:39Z
Updated: 2026-08-26T20:11:41Z

---

## What happened

PR #771 (files: `.oxlintrc.json`, `_githooks/pre-commit`, `bun.lock`, `package.json`, `scripts/done-means/750-precommit-lint-gate-fires.sh`) failed the `validate` check with `Missing '## Contract Parity' section.` None of those paths are in `contracts/parity-paths.txt`.

## Cause

`.github/workflows/pr-body.yml` step `contract-paths`:

```sh
git diff --quiet "${BASE_SHA}" "${HEAD_SHA}" -- $(cat contracts/parity-paths.txt)
```

`BASE_SHA` is the base branch TIP, and a two-dot diff between the tip of main and the PR head includes every main-side commit the branch does not have. #771 was cut from `120812a`, 4 commits behind `96978a8`; one of those (#768) touched `src/contract.ts`, so the diff was non-empty and `required=true`.

## Fix

Diff from the merge base: `git diff --quiet "${BASE_SHA}...${HEAD_SHA}" -- ...` (three-dot), or `git diff --quiet "$(git merge-base "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA")" "$HEAD_SHA" -- ...`. The `contract-parity` job in `ci.yml:493` uses the same two-dot form and has the same defect.

## Claim state

WRITTEN (this report). Workaround applied on #771: branch updated to main so the two-dot diff is clean.

Same two-dot class, second site: `scripts/done-means/handoff-validates.sh:39` runs `git diff --name-only origin/main -- '_DOCS/_handoff/*.md'` (working tree vs main). Observed 2026-08-26 on PR #785 at head 1a790c3: after #824 added `_DOCS/_handoff/2026-08-26-lint-sweep-l2-session3.md` to main, the check listed that file for a branch that never touched it and failed with "HARNESS: cannot read". Line 38 already has the three-dot form; line 39 should go, or restrict to files present in HEAD. Workaround used: merge origin/main into the branch.
